turns.question: It's 10 November 2026. How many orders did we get last fiscal quarter, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: We got 217 orders (cancelled included) in fiscal Q3 2026, 1 August to 31 October 2026, counted on the day each order was placed. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
